hero.title: Where Ancient Wonders Meet Modern Comfort
hero.subtitle: Experience the magic of the Great Pyramids from our rooftop terrace. HENU Hotel — your gateway to 5,000 years of history.

about.title: Welcome to HENU
about.subtitle: A Boutique Hotel in the Heart of History
about.p1: Nestled in the historic village of Nazlet El-Semman, just steps from the Great Pyramids of Giza and the Sphinx, HENU Hotel offers an unparalleled experience where ancient Egypt comes alive.
about.p2: Our 25 beautifully appointed rooms feature Pharaonic-inspired décor, marble bathrooms, and modern amenities. Wake up to breathtaking views of the Pyramids from our rooftop terrace — a sight that has captivated travelers for millennia.

rooms.title: Our Accommodation
rooms.subtitle: Choose your perfect room and wake up to the wonders of ancient Egypt

single.name: Single Room
single.desc: A cozy retreat for solo travelers, featuring a comfortable single bed, marble bathroom, and elegant Pharaonic décor.

double.name: Double Room
double.desc: Spacious room with a double bed, sitting area, marble bathroom, and views of the lush garden or historic village.

triple.name: Triple / Family Room
triple.desc: Perfect for families or groups, featuring three single beds, a spacious layout, marble bathroom, and garden views.

suite.name: King Suite — Pyramids View
suite.desc: Our premier room featuring a king-size bed, Pharaonic wall art, marble bathroom, and a private balcony with direct views of the Great Pyramids and Sphinx.

experiences.title: Experiences & Tours
experiences.subtitle: Discover the magic of Egypt with our curated experiences

horse.title: Horse & Camel Rides
horse.desc: Explore the Pyramids plateau on horseback or camelback at sunrise or sunset — an unforgettable adventure through 5,000 years of history.

dayTrips.title: Day Trips
dayTrips.desc: Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum, Saqqara Step Pyramid, and the ancient city of Memphis — all in one amazing day trip.

cairoTours.title: Cairo City Tours
cairoTours.desc: Discover the vibrant streets of Cairo — from Khan El-Khalili bazaar to the Citadel of Saladin and Islamic Cairo's stunning mosques.

transfers.title: Transfers & Logistics
transfers.desc: Airport transfers, inter-city transport, and hotel bookings across Egypt. Let us handle the logistics while you enjoy the journey.

b2b.title: B2B & Hotel Management
b2b.subtitle: Professional hospitality services for hotels and partners

training.title: Training & Internships
training.desc: We offer comprehensive hospitality training programs and internship rotations for aspiring hotel professionals. Our programs cover front desk operations, housekeeping management, guest relations, and food & beverage service.

management.title: Hotel Management
management.desc: End-to-end management services for small and boutique hotels. From staffing and training to operations and quality assurance — we bring our expertise to your property.

staffing.title: Professional Staffing
staffing.desc: Access our curated database of trained hospitality professionals. We provide vetted, trained staff for hotels across Egypt — from reception to housekeeping to kitchen staff.

partnerships.title: Strategic Partnerships
partnerships.desc: Collaborate with HENU for mutual growth. We partner with tour operators, travel agencies, and hospitality brands to create exceptional guest experiences.

b2b.introDesc: HENU Hotel extends its hospitality expertise beyond our own walls. We provide comprehensive solutions for hotels and partners.

careers.title: Join Our Team
careers.subtitle: Build your career in hospitality with HENU Hotel
careers.intro: At HENU, we believe our team is our greatest asset. We're always looking for passionate individuals who share our commitment to exceptional hospitality.
careers.benefit1Desc: Continuous training and growth opportunities in the hospitality industry.
careers.benefit2Desc: Work at one of the most iconic locations in the world — the Pyramids of Giza.
careers.benefit3Desc: Interact with guests from around the world and develop your language skills.
careers.benefit4Desc: Join a supportive, family-like team that values every member.
careers.applyDesc: Submit your CV and we'll contact you when a suitable position opens.
careers.staffingDesc: Looking for hotel work in Egypt? Register in our staffing database. We connect trained professionals with hotels across the country.

contact.title: Contact & Booking
contact.subtitle: Reserve your stay at HENU Hotel or reach out with any questions

contact.paymentDesc: We currently accept payment at the property upon arrival. No advance payment required.
contact.successDesc: Thank you! We'll confirm your reservation within 24 hours via WhatsApp or email.

testimonials.title: What Our Guests Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real reviews from travelers who stayed with us

t1.text: The rooftop view of the Pyramids at sunset is absolutely breathtaking. The rooms are beautifully decorated with Egyptian art. The staff went above and beyond to make our stay memorable.
t1.author: Sarah M.

t2.text: Perfect location — literally steps from the Pyramids! The Pharaonic-themed rooms are gorgeous and the marble bathrooms are luxurious. Great value for money.
t2.author: Marco R.

t3.text: We booked a camel ride through the hotel and it was the highlight of our trip. The hotel arranged everything perfectly. Can't wait to come back!
t3.author: Anna K.
